WHO ARE WE?

Our Story

Born in Jakarta

Founded in 2015 by the Dimas family, Mamma Mia Restaurant was born from a simple love of cooking for neighbors. The praise they received for their home cooking inspired them to turn it into a full restaurant that stands to this day.

Our Philosophy

Rooted in the principles of simplicity, respect for local ingredients, and togetherness. An Italian restaurant is more than just a place to eat — it is a cultural hub where tradition, family warmth, and authentic flavors are kept alive.
